All those nights he had wondered whether the beam reached anyone at all, and here was proof folded into a scrap of paper, delivered by the indifferent sea.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市褪去了所有伪装。路灯把空旷的街道染成昏黄，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，轮胎碾过积水的声音格外清晰。早点铺的灯已经亮了，蒸笼里白雾升腾，老板娘在案板前揉面，动作不紧不慢。环卫工人推着车沿街而行，扫帚划过地面发出沙沙的低语。远处高楼的轮廓在天际线上静默伫立，几扇窗口透出微光——也许是失眠的人，也许是加班到天明的灵魂。空气里弥漫着潮湿与清冷，这座城市在黎明前最深的寂静中缓缓呼吸，等待第一缕晨光将它重新唤醒。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself with a smaller version of that same problem—like looking up a word in the dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you also need to look up.\n• Every recursive function needs a \"base case,\" which is the simplest version of the problem that it can answer right away without calling itself again—otherwise it would keep going forever like two mirrors facing each other.\n• So the function keeps breaking the big problem into smaller pieces, calling itself each time, until it hits the base case, and then it stacks all the small answers back together to get the final answer."}
